###############################################################################
# Terraform configuration
###############################################################################

terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.5.0"

  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 5.0"
    }
    random = {
      source  = "hashicorp/random"
      version = ">= 3.5.0"
    }
  }
}

###############################################################################
# Multi-region provider configurations
###############################################################################

provider "aws" {
  alias  = "main"
  region = "us-west-1"
}

provider "aws" {
  alias  = "us-east"
  region = "us-east-1"
}

provider "aws" {
  alias  = "eu-central"
  region = "eu-central-1"
}

provider "aws" {
  alias  = "ap-southeast"
  region = "ap-southeast-1"
}

###############################################################################
# Variables
###############################################################################

variable "domain_name" {
  description = "Domain name of the Route 53 hosted zone used for weighted database routing"
  type        = string
  default     = "example.com"
}

variable "tags" {
  description = "Common tags applied uniformly across all tagged resources"
  type        = map(string)
  default = {
    Project     = "global-postgres-replication"
    Environment = "production"
    ManagedBy   = "terraform"
  }
}

###############################################################################
# Locals
###############################################################################

locals {
  db_engine         = "postgres"
  db_instance_class = "db.t3.medium"
  db_port           = 5432
  db_name           = "appdb"

  weighted_record_name = "db.${aws_route53_zone.main.name}"
}

###############################################################################
# Availability zone lookups (one per provider alias, never hardcoded)
###############################################################################

data "aws_availability_zones" "main" {
  provider = aws.main
  state    = "available"
}

data "aws_availability_zones" "us_east" {
  provider = aws.us-east
  state    = "available"
}

data "aws_availability_zones" "eu_central" {
  provider = aws.eu-central
  state    = "available"
}

data "aws_availability_zones" "ap_southeast" {
  provider = aws.ap-southeast
  state    = "available"
}

###############################################################################
# Networking and KMS: us-west-1 (primary region)
###############################################################################

resource "aws_vpc" "main" {
  provider             = aws.main
  cidr_block           = "10.10.0.0/16"
  enable_dns_support   = true
  enable_dns_hostnames = true

  tags = merge(var.tags, { Name = "primary-vpc" })
}

resource "aws_subnet" "main_a" {
  provider                = aws.main
  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.main.id
  cidr_block              = "10.10.0.0/20"
  availability_zone       = data.aws_availability_zones.main.names[0]
  map_public_ip_on_launch = false

  tags = merge(var.tags, { Name = "primary-db-subnet-a" })
}

resource "aws_subnet" "main_b" {
  provider                = aws.main
  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.main.id
  cidr_block              = "10.10.16.0/20"
  availability_zone       = data.aws_availability_zones.main.names[1]
  map_public_ip_on_launch = false

  tags = merge(var.tags, { Name = "primary-db-subnet-b" })
}

resource "aws_db_subnet_group" "main" {
  provider   = aws.main
  name       = "primary-db-subnets"
  subnet_ids = [aws_subnet.main_a.id, aws_subnet.main_b.id]

  tags = merge(var.tags, { Name = "primary-db-subnets" })
}

resource "aws_security_group" "main" {
  provider    = aws.main
  name        = "primary-db-sg"
  description = "PostgreSQL access to the primary RDS instance from within its VPC only"
  vpc_id      = aws_vpc.main.id

  ingress {
    description = "PostgreSQL from within the VPC"
    from_port   = local.db_port
    to_port     = local.db_port
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = [aws_vpc.main.cidr_block]
  }

  egress {
    description = "Allow all outbound"
    from_port   = 0
    to_port     = 0
    protocol    = "-1"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }

  tags = merge(var.tags, { Name = "primary-db-sg" })
}

resource "aws_kms_key" "main" {
  provider                = aws.main
  description             = "KMS key for the primary RDS instance and its credentials secret (us-west-1)"
  deletion_window_in_days = 7
  enable_key_rotation     = true

  tags = merge(var.tags, { Name = "primary-rds-kms" })
}

###############################################################################
# Networking and KMS: us-east-1
###############################################################################

resource "aws_vpc" "us_east" {
  provider             = aws.us-east
  cidr_block           = "10.11.0.0/16"
  enable_dns_support   = true
  enable_dns_hostnames = true

  tags = merge(var.tags, { Name = "replica-us-east-vpc" })
}

resource "aws_subnet" "us_east_a" {
  provider                = aws.us-east
  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.us_east.id
  cidr_block              = "10.11.0.0/20"
  availability_zone       = data.aws_availability_zones.us_east.names[0]
  map_public_ip_on_launch = false

  tags = merge(var.tags, { Name = "replica-us-east-db-subnet-a" })
}

resource "aws_subnet" "us_east_b" {
  provider                = aws.us-east
  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.us_east.id
  cidr_block              = "10.11.16.0/20"
  availability_zone       = data.aws_availability_zones.us_east.names[1]
  map_public_ip_on_launch = false

  tags = merge(var.tags, { Name = "replica-us-east-db-subnet-b" })
}

resource "aws_db_subnet_group" "us_east" {
  provider   = aws.us-east
  name       = "replica-us-east-db-subnets"
  subnet_ids = [aws_subnet.us_east_a.id, aws_subnet.us_east_b.id]

  tags = merge(var.tags, { Name = "replica-us-east-db-subnets" })
}

resource "aws_security_group" "us_east" {
  provider    = aws.us-east
  name        = "replica-us-east-db-sg"
  description = "PostgreSQL access to the us-east-1 read replica from within its VPC only"
  vpc_id      = aws_vpc.us_east.id

  ingress {
    description = "PostgreSQL from within the VPC"
    from_port   = local.db_port
    to_port     = local.db_port
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = [aws_vpc.us_east.cidr_block]
  }

  egress {
    description = "Allow all outbound"
    from_port   = 0
    to_port     = 0
    protocol    = "-1"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }

  tags = merge(var.tags, { Name = "replica-us-east-db-sg" })
}

resource "aws_kms_key" "us_east" {
  provider                = aws.us-east
  description             = "KMS key for the us-east-1 read replica"
  deletion_window_in_days = 7
  enable_key_rotation     = true

  tags = merge(var.tags, { Name = "replica-us-east-rds-kms" })
}

###############################################################################
# Networking and KMS: eu-central-1
###############################################################################

resource "aws_vpc" "eu_central" {
  provider             = aws.eu-central
  cidr_block           = "10.12.0.0/16"
  enable_dns_support   = true
  enable_dns_hostnames = true

  tags = merge(var.tags, { Name = "replica-eu-central-vpc" })
}

resource "aws_subnet" "eu_central_a" {
  provider                = aws.eu-central
  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.eu_central.id
  cidr_block              = "10.12.0.0/20"
  availability_zone       = data.aws_availability_zones.eu_central.names[0]
  map_public_ip_on_launch = false

  tags = merge(var.tags, { Name = "replica-eu-central-db-subnet-a" })
}

resource "aws_subnet" "eu_central_b" {
  provider                = aws.eu-central
  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.eu_central.id
  cidr_block              = "10.12.16.0/20"
  availability_zone       = data.aws_availability_zones.eu_central.names[1]
  map_public_ip_on_launch = false

  tags = merge(var.tags, { Name = "replica-eu-central-db-subnet-b" })
}

resource "aws_db_subnet_group" "eu_central" {
  provider   = aws.eu-central
  name       = "replica-eu-central-db-subnets"
  subnet_ids = [aws_subnet.eu_central_a.id, aws_subnet.eu_central_b.id]

  tags = merge(var.tags, { Name = "replica-eu-central-db-subnets" })
}

resource "aws_security_group" "eu_central" {
  provider    = aws.eu-central
  name        = "replica-eu-central-db-sg"
  description = "PostgreSQL access to the eu-central-1 read replica from within its VPC only"
  vpc_id      = aws_vpc.eu_central.id

  ingress {
    description = "PostgreSQL from within the VPC"
    from_port   = local.db_port
    to_port     = local.db_port
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = [aws_vpc.eu_central.cidr_block]
  }

  egress {
    description = "Allow all outbound"
    from_port   = 0
    to_port     = 0
    protocol    = "-1"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }

  tags = merge(var.tags, { Name = "replica-eu-central-db-sg" })
}

resource "aws_kms_key" "eu_central" {
  provider                = aws.eu-central
  description             = "KMS key for the eu-central-1 read replica"
  deletion_window_in_days = 7
  enable_key_rotation     = true

  tags = merge(var.tags, { Name = "replica-eu-central-rds-kms" })
}

###############################################################################
# Networking and KMS: ap-southeast-1
###############################################################################

resource "aws_vpc" "ap_southeast" {
  provider             = aws.ap-southeast
  cidr_block           = "10.13.0.0/16"
  enable_dns_support   = true
  enable_dns_hostnames = true

  tags = merge(var.tags, { Name = "replica-ap-southeast-vpc" })
}

resource "aws_subnet" "ap_southeast_a" {
  provider                = aws.ap-southeast
  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.ap_southeast.id
  cidr_block              = "10.13.0.0/20"
  availability_zone       = data.aws_availability_zones.ap_southeast.names[0]
  map_public_ip_on_launch = false

  tags = merge(var.tags, { Name = "replica-ap-southeast-db-subnet-a" })
}

resource "aws_subnet" "ap_southeast_b" {
  provider                = aws.ap-southeast
  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.ap_southeast.id
  cidr_block              = "10.13.16.0/20"
  availability_zone       = data.aws_availability_zones.ap_southeast.names[1]
  map_public_ip_on_launch = false

  tags = merge(var.tags, { Name = "replica-ap-southeast-db-subnet-b" })
}

resource "aws_db_subnet_group" "ap_southeast" {
  provider   = aws.ap-southeast
  name       = "replica-ap-southeast-db-subnets"
  subnet_ids = [aws_subnet.ap_southeast_a.id, aws_subnet.ap_southeast_b.id]

  tags = merge(var.tags, { Name = "replica-ap-southeast-db-subnets" })
}

resource "aws_security_group" "ap_southeast" {
  provider    = aws.ap-southeast
  name        = "replica-ap-southeast-db-sg"
  description = "PostgreSQL access to the ap-southeast-1 read replica from within its VPC only"
  vpc_id      = aws_vpc.ap_southeast.id

  ingress {
    description = "PostgreSQL from within the VPC"
    from_port   = local.db_port
    to_port     = local.db_port
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = [aws_vpc.ap_southeast.cidr_block]
  }

  egress {
    description = "Allow all outbound"
    from_port   = 0
    to_port     = 0
    protocol    = "-1"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }

  tags = merge(var.tags, { Name = "replica-ap-southeast-db-sg" })
}

resource "aws_kms_key" "ap_southeast" {
  provider                = aws.ap-southeast
  description             = "KMS key for the ap-southeast-1 read replica"
  deletion_window_in_days = 7
  enable_key_rotation     = true

  tags = merge(var.tags, { Name = "replica-ap-southeast-rds-kms" })
}

###############################################################################
# Master credentials: generated and stored in Secrets Manager (us-west-1)
###############################################################################

resource "random_pet" "db_username" {
  length    = 1
  prefix    = "db"
  separator = ""
}

resource "random_password" "db_master_password" {
  length           = 32
  special          = true
  override_special = "!#$%&*()-_=+[]{}:?"
}

resource "random_id" "final_snapshot_suffix" {
  byte_length = 4
}

resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret" "db_master_credentials" {
  provider    = aws.main
  name        = "rds-primary-master-credentials"
  description = "Master credentials for the primary PostgreSQL instance in us-west-1"
  kms_key_id  = aws_kms_key.main.id

  tags = merge(var.tags, { Name = "rds-primary-master-credentials" })
}

resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret_version" "db_master_credentials" {
  provider  = aws.main
  secret_id = aws_secretsmanager_secret.db_master_credentials.id

  secret_string = jsonencode({
    username = random_pet.db_username.id
    password = random_password.db_master_password.result
  })
}

###############################################################################
# Primary database instance (us-west-1)
###############################################################################

resource "aws_db_instance" "primary" {
  provider                   = aws.main
  identifier                 = "primary"
  engine                     = local.db_engine
  instance_class             = local.db_instance_class
  allocated_storage          = 50
  storage_type               = "gp3"
  storage_encrypted          = true
  kms_key_id                 = aws_kms_key.main.arn
  db_name                    = local.db_name
  username                   = random_pet.db_username.id
  password                   = random_password.db_master_password.result
  port                       = local.db_port
  db_subnet_group_name       = aws_db_subnet_group.main.name
  vpc_security_group_ids     = [aws_security_group.main.id]
  publicly_accessible        = false
  multi_az                   = false
  auto_minor_version_upgrade = true
  copy_tags_to_snapshot      = true
  backup_retention_period    = 7
  deletion_protection        = true
  skip_final_snapshot        = false
  final_snapshot_identifier  = "primary-final-${random_id.final_snapshot_suffix.hex}"

  tags = merge(var.tags, { Name = "primary" })

  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}

###############################################################################
# Cross-region read replicas
###############################################################################

resource "aws_db_instance" "replica_us_east" {
  provider               = aws.us-east
  identifier             = "replica-us-east"
  replicate_source_db    = aws_db_instance.primary.arn
  instance_class         = local.db_instance_class
  storage_encrypted      = true
  kms_key_id             = aws_kms_key.us_east.arn
  db_subnet_group_name   = aws_db_subnet_group.us_east.name
  vpc_security_group_ids = [aws_security_group.us_east.id]
  publicly_accessible    = false
  deletion_protection    = true
  skip_final_snapshot    = true

  tags = merge(var.tags, { Name = "replica_us_east" })

  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}

resource "aws_db_instance" "replica_eu_central" {
  provider               = aws.eu-central
  identifier             = "replica-eu-central"
  replicate_source_db    = aws_db_instance.primary.arn
  instance_class         = local.db_instance_class
  storage_encrypted      = true
  kms_key_id             = aws_kms_key.eu_central.arn
  db_subnet_group_name   = aws_db_subnet_group.eu_central.name
  vpc_security_group_ids = [aws_security_group.eu_central.id]
  publicly_accessible    = false
  deletion_protection    = true
  skip_final_snapshot    = true

  tags = merge(var.tags, { Name = "replica_eu_central" })

  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}

resource "aws_db_instance" "replica_ap_southeast" {
  provider               = aws.ap-southeast
  identifier             = "replica-ap-southeast"
  replicate_source_db    = aws_db_instance.primary.arn
  instance_class         = local.db_instance_class
  storage_encrypted      = true
  kms_key_id             = aws_kms_key.ap_southeast.arn
  db_subnet_group_name   = aws_db_subnet_group.ap_southeast.name
  vpc_security_group_ids = [aws_security_group.ap_southeast.id]
  publicly_accessible    = false
  deletion_protection    = true
  skip_final_snapshot    = true

  tags = merge(var.tags, { Name = "replica_ap_southeast" })

  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}

###############################################################################
# Route 53 hosted zone and weighted routing records
###############################################################################

resource "aws_route53_zone" "main" {
  provider = aws.main
  name     = var.domain_name

  tags = merge(var.tags, { Name = "main" })
}

resource "aws_route53_record" "replica_us_east" {
  provider       = aws.main
  zone_id        = aws_route53_zone.main.zone_id
  name           = local.weighted_record_name
  type           = "CNAME"
  ttl            = 60
  records        = [aws_db_instance.replica_us_east.address]
  set_identifier = "us-east"

  weighted_routing_policy {
    weight = 100
  }
}

resource "aws_route53_record" "replica_eu_central" {
  provider       = aws.main
  zone_id        = aws_route53_zone.main.zone_id
  name           = local.weighted_record_name
  type           = "CNAME"
  ttl            = 60
  records        = [aws_db_instance.replica_eu_central.address]
  set_identifier = "eu-central"

  weighted_routing_policy {
    weight = 100
  }
}

resource "aws_route53_record" "replica_ap_southeast" {
  provider       = aws.main
  zone_id        = aws_route53_zone.main.zone_id
  name           = local.weighted_record_name
  type           = "CNAME"
  ttl            = 60
  records        = [aws_db_instance.replica_ap_southeast.address]
  set_identifier = "ap-southeast"

  weighted_routing_policy {
    weight = 100
  }
}

###############################################################################
# Outputs
###############################################################################

output "hosted_zone_id" {
  description = "ID of the main Route 53 hosted zone"
  value       = aws_route53_zone.main.zone_id
}

output "hosted_zone_name_servers" {
  description = "Name servers of the main Route 53 hosted zone"
  value       = aws_route53_zone.main.name_servers
}

output "weighted_record_fqdn" {
  description = "FQDN of the weighted CNAME record splitting traffic across the three replicas"
  value       = aws_route53_record.replica_us_east.fqdn
}

output "replica_us_east_endpoint" {
  description = "Endpoint of the us-east-1 read replica"
  value       = aws_db_instance.replica_us_east.address
}

output "replica_eu_central_endpoint" {
  description = "Endpoint of the eu-central-1 read replica"
  value       = aws_db_instance.replica_eu_central.address
}

output "replica_ap_southeast_endpoint" {
  description = "Endpoint of the ap-southeast-1 read replica"
  value       = aws_db_instance.replica_ap_southeast.address
}

output "primary_endpoint" {
  description = "Endpoint of the primary database instance"
  value       = aws_db_instance.primary.address
}

output "master_credentials_secret_arn" {
  description = "ARN of the Secrets Manager secret storing the master credentials"
  value       = aws_secretsmanager_secret.db_master_credentials.arn
}
